items: [new] A Fab product's Status page shows its checks, not the journey of a map. In a Fab product the arrows are the 7 stations of the Fab checklist (Project, Content, Build, Listing, Extra, Zip, Submit), each with its green count and its state (done, now, stopped by a failed check); the loop bar is the verdict with the percentage and the counts; a click on a station lists its checks with state, who does it, the evidence and what to do. The map-only blocks (hero cards, next action, Island line, release tabs) are hidden there. The Checklist page stays the place to tick your checks and paste the UEFN validation.
release.title: v1.123.0 — A Fab product's workflow is its checks
